entities.name: Jabras
entities.description: A corpulent, smug councilor of Femeref who backed the Council's policy against aiding the Efravan caravan.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Petitioner who asked the Council to lift the decree against aiding the Efravan caravan.

entities.name: Gbega
entities.description: A councilor who supported Jabras's stance.

entities.name: Awateh
entities.description: A councilor who supported Jabras's stance.

entities.name: Sidar Teshunda
entities.description: Man who welcomed the Efravan to Femeref despite the councilors' protests.

entities.name: Efravan
entities.description: A caravan whose people needed aid and were suspected of Phyrexian influence.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A place on Jamuraa, Dominaria, governed by the Council of Voices.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Figure associated with the Efravan in the councilors' fears.

events.summary: In the Great Chamber, Niambi petitions the Council to lift the decree against aiding the Efravan; Jabras and others refuse.
events.quote: maintained a firm stance against assisting

events.summary: Jabras, Awateh and Gbega see Niambi take Teshunda to the Efravan mines, and follow too late; Teshunda welcomes the Efravan to Femeref.
events.quote: Teshunda had made up his mind and had welcomed the Efravan to Femeref

relations.quote: His presence in the Council of Voices is significant
When Niambi's fervent pleas failed to sway the Council, Jabras and others dismissed her
